visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a green bikini and a white cover-up shirt, stands on a wooden deck by a swimming pool. Behind her is a large white multi-story resort building with arched balconies. She turns to the camera, smiling, and takes off her white shirt to reveal her swimsuit. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a resort advertisement and a sign for 'Away Chiang Mai Thapae Resort'. The woman walks through a white archway into a courtyard lined with green bushes and white walls under a bright, sunny sky. (3) The woman climbs out of the swimming pool using the metal steps, smiling joyfully at the camera. She sits on the pool edge, posing with a straw hat and floral sandals placed beside her. In the background, other guests are faintly visible in the water. (4) The scene shifts to an indoor hotel room tour. The camera pans through a bedroom with twin beds and a tropical-themed headboard mural, then into a modern bathroom featuring a marble-topped vanity and a glass-enclosed shower area with brown tiles. (5) The woman, now wearing a white lace dress over her swimsuit and a straw hat, stands on a balcony. She points out a white jetted bathtub located on the outdoor balcony. She gestures towards the view of the resort and neighboring buildings under the bright daylight. (6) The video concludes with the main woman and another female friend in sunglasses posing together by the pool, smiling and making peace signs at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic electronic pop track featuring a steady 4/4 drum beat and bright synthesizer pads. The vibe is upbeat and modern. No speech is present. (2) A splashing water sound marks a transition. A high-pitched, friendly female voice begins speaking enthusiastically in Mandarin. She uses a high speech rate with rising intonations, expressing delight about the poolside environment. (3) A subtle digital 'ding' sound occurs as visual text pops up. The BGM continues with female vocals in English singing a catchy hook. The narrator continues her description with high vocal arousal. (4) As the scene moves indoors, a slight 'whoosh' transition sound is heard. The ambient noise becomes a clean room tone. The female narrator's voice remains dominant and clear over the background music, detailing room features. (5) The narrator's speech becomes more frantic and excited as she shows the outdoor bathtub. The BGM maintains its tempo until the end, where it slightly fades out during the final group pose.
